summary: Static code review of source commit 128fe91d2a0f. No fresh runtime evidence available (false); profitability and canary/live readiness cannot be claimed. Review covers Solana/EVM strategy families, market feature adapters, shadow execution, forecast plumbing and Strategy Lab governance. Proposals are research/improvement actions only - none advance to LIVE.

proposals.title: Liquidity-Confirmed Momentum Signal: net_edge_bps gate is missing upper-bound guard against stale quotes
proposals.hypothesis: Trades passing the net_edge_bps > threshold gate may still execute on stale quotes when quote_age_ms is not bounded per-chain. Adding a per-chain maximum quote age check before edge evaluation prevents false positives from aged liquidity data.
proposals.shadow_test: In SHADOW mode: inject a MarketFeatures snapshot with quote_age_ms > chain-specific threshold and gross_edge_bps = positive value. Verify the strategy gate rejects the signal. Compare participation/rejection counts over a 48h shadow window and confirm no net-negative trades attributable to stale-quote acceptance.

evidence.detail: CrossChainStrategySignal._evaluate_signal does not enforce a maximum quote_age_ms bound before computing net edge. Stale quotes can pass the positive-edge gate.
MarketFeatures.validate() checks quote_age_ms >= 0 but imposes no upper bound; chain-specific maximums (e.g. 800 ms Solana, 3000 ms EVM) are not enforced.

proposals.research_plan: Shadow test both chains with controlled quote_age injections. Compare trade outcomes with and without the stale-quote gate over a minimum of 3 evaluation windows (per strategy_lab MIN_EVALUATION_WINDOWS).
proposals.net_pnl_risk: Stale quotes inflate apparent gross_edge_bps, causing real slippage to exceed forecast slippage_bps and erode net P&L. Cost: quantifiable via execution_failures and slippage_cost fields in strategy_lab_windows.

proposals.title: Profitable-Wallet Cohort Pattern: research plan for multi-wallet route/behaviour analysis is specified but not scheduled
proposals.hypothesis: The repository's strategy_lab_research.py defines PUBLIC_RESEARCH_TOOLS and FORECAST_RESEARCH_SPEC but no scheduled Dune/Etherscan query materialises wallet-cohort data into the strategy_lab_registry. A cohort of wallets with consistently positive money-weighted net P&L (not raw win rate) across >= 3 market regimes and >= 2 chains would provide evidence to derive route-pattern and timing strategies without direct leader copying.
proposals.shadow_test: Collect >= 30 wallets with: (a) >= 50 resolved trades on Dune/Etherscan per chain; (b) profit factor >= 1.10 in >= 3 distinct 30-day windows; (c) money-weighted net P&L positive after estimated gas/fees. Register a SHADOW strategy with the derived timing/route features. After >= 8 shadow trades, compare profit factor and largest loss against MIN_PROFIT_FACTOR = 1.10.

evidence.detail: PUBLIC_RESEARCH_TOOLS lists Dune, Etherscan API V2 and DEX Screener as research sources but no module schedules these queries or feeds results into strategy_lab_registry.
MIN_PROFIT_FACTOR, MIN_EVALUATION_WINDOWS and MIN_EVALUATION_TRADES define evaluation thresholds but no automated cohort-research pipeline populates the registry from external sources.

proposals.research_plan: 1) Write Dune query for Solana DEX trades by wallet cohort (profit factor > 1.1, >= 3 regime windows). 2) Mirror with Etherscan API V2 for EVM. 3) Extract repeated route/token/timing patterns. 4) Register SHADOW strategy. 5) Evaluate under shadow_strategy_executor with real market features.
proposals.net_pnl_risk: Without cohort evidence, any derived strategy is speculative. Research more before any SHADOW implementation to avoid manufacturing edge from insufficient sample sizes.

proposals.title: Forecast Calibration: forecast_positive_edge_probability field is defined but calibration pipeline is absent
proposals.hypothesis: MarketFeatures.forecast_positive_edge_probability is structurally present but no calibration metric (Brier score/log-loss) is computed over shadow trades, no train/validation/test split is enforced, and no abstain rule for low-confidence predictions is implemented. A miscalibrated forecast passes the positive-edge gate at a rate that can degrade net P&L silently.
proposals.shadow_test: Over a 72h shadow window on both chains: compute Brier score and log-loss for forecast_positive_edge_probability against realised binary net_profit > 0 outcomes recorded in strategy_lab_windows. Require Brier score <= 0.20 and log-loss <= 0.50 before the forecast gate is considered reliable. Implement abstain rule: skip signal when forecast_uncertainty > 0.4.

evidence.detail: forecast_positive_edge_probability is read from MarketFeatures but no calibration or abstain-threshold logic is applied before the gate decision.
forecast_uncertainty field exists and defaults to 1.0 (maximum uncertainty) but no consumer enforces an abstain rule when uncertainty is high.

proposals.research_plan: 1) Instrument shadow_strategy_executor to log (forecast_positive_edge_probability, forecast_uncertainty, realised_net_profit) per trade. 2) After >= 100 shadow observations per chain, compute calibration metrics. 3) Tune abstain threshold on validation set. 4) Re-evaluate profit factor on held-out test set. Use strict time-ordered split - no lookahead.
proposals.net_pnl_risk: Overconfident or miscalibrated forecasts increase loss frequency. A well-calibrated abstain rule reduces participation but improves money-weighted net P&L by eliminating low-confidence trades with negative expected edge.

proposals.title: New-Liquidity Quality Strategy: pool_age_seconds signal is captured but no strategy family uses it as a primary filter
proposals.hypothesis: pool_age_seconds is a MarketFeatures field but no registered strategy family uses it as a primary entry filter. New pools frequently carry elevated rug/honeypot risk but also sometimes carry outsized early-momentum edge. A strategy that gates entry on pool_age_seconds within [MIN_POOL_AGE, MAX_POOL_AGE] combined with sellability_score >= 0.7 and liquidity_score >= 0.5 could capture early legitimate liquidity without honeypot exposure.
proposals.shadow_test: Register a SHADOW strategy with parameters: pool_age_seconds in [300, 7200], sellability_score >= 0.7, liquidity_score >= 0.5, net_edge_bps > 50. Run for >= 3 evaluation windows. Record participation rate, win rate, profit factor and largest_loss. A strategy where profit factor < 1.0 or largest_loss dominates gross_profit must be retired immediately. Do not promote to ACTIVE without >= 8 shadow trades meeting all quality gates.

evidence.detail: pool_age_seconds field is present in MarketFeatures but grep across strategy_lab.py and cross_chain_strategy_signals.py shows no strategy uses it as a primary filter condition.
STRATEGY_SOURCES includes MARKET_NATIVE but no registered strategy in the codebase uses pool_age as a discriminating feature for new-liquidity quality detection.

proposals.research_plan: 1) Use DEX Screener API to retrieve pools < 2h old on both chains; measure distribution of sellability outcomes. 2) Compute profit factor for different pool-age brackets across a historical Dune dataset. 3) Calibrate MIN/MAX pool age bounds before shadow registration.
proposals.net_pnl_risk: New-pool strategies carry high rug/exit risk. The strategy must never weaken sellability_score or liquidity_score gates to increase trade count. Largest loss controls are paramount.

evidence_gaps: No fresh runtime evidence (fresh_runtime_evidence=false). Profitability and live/canary readiness cannot be claimed for any proposal.
No strategy_lab_windows rows are available in this static review; profit factor and net P&L figures are estimates only.
Cohort wallet analysis (Dune/Etherscan) has not been run; PROP-COPILOT-002 depends on this data.
Forecast calibration metrics (Brier/log-loss) are absent; PROP-COPILOT-003 cannot be validated without shadow trade data.
